headline: AI-generated iPhone 18 Pro ad imagined in a new dark cherry color
summary: An AI model created a mock advertisement for the unreleased iPhone 18 Pro, showcasing a striking dark cherry color option.
details: An AI model has generated a compelling mock advertisement for Apple's unreleased iPhone 18 Pro, envisioning the device in a vibrant dark cherry hue.

The ad, created by an AI, features a model using the phone outside an Apple Store, highlighting the potential new color. This concept taps into the anticipation surrounding Apple's upcoming 'Rise and Surprise' event.
While the iPhone 18 Pro is still speculative, the AI-generated ad offers a glimpse into potential design directions and colorways that could feature in future Apple devices.
